headline: Kissing the Pope's hand on the Pincio
summary: While the children play leapfrog, Pope Pius IX passes in his sedan chair. Young "Teedie" has just boasted that no true American believes in popes, yet when the pontiff holds out his hand, Roosevelt kisses it, as Conie later recalled and his diary confirms.

events.detail: Kisses the hand of Pope Pius IX as he passes in a sedan chair
Records the encounter in his diary

tr_quotes.text: We saw the Pope and we walked along and he extended his hand to me and I kissed it!! Hem! Hem!
